Actual GuestUITurns throws wake/document because its policy permits Previous only at revision 6. Ownership.swift:402 and :198 convert that refusal into a protocol stop.

After health, tap the enabled Entries or Tasks directly from revision 3. Both actual guest branches produce valid revision-4 packets, verified with the real Swift reconciler and Java UiPacket. Java readback returns null because it insists revision 4 is page 2. applyGuest returns false and Swift presentation takes its native-apply failure path. Java also refuses the revision-5 first-page packet from immediate Previous when the storage layer is bypassed.
